svg.text: #666 Enterprise GPU Confidential Computing (H200/B200 CC-On + TDX/SEV-SNP) Boundary & Overhead Sizer
Why HBM3e has 0% crypto tax (<2.1% 1-GPU overhead), why PCIe Bounce Buffers cost -28.5% on TP=8, and how PPCIE NVLink CC cuts it to 4.8%
Where Does AES-GCM-256 Encryption Actually Happen in CC-On?
• INSIDE GPU Package (HBM3e ↔ SM Tensor Cores): Plaintext at 4.8–8.0 TB/s!
Physical package is attestation-locked; zero HBM encryption penalty.
• HOST CPU (Intel TDX / AMD SEV-SNP) ↔ GPU PCIe Gen5 Boundary:
GPUDirect P2P disabled in single-GPU CC mode! Every DMA crosses an
unencrypted SWIOTLB Bounce Buffer + Copy Engine AES-GCM-256.
Effective Host-to-Device BW drops from 56.0 GB/s to 14.8 GB/s (-73.6%).
• Why Single-GPU LLM Inference Only Loses 1.8%–2.1% TPS:
Only Token IDs (18.4 KB/req = 0.36 ms) cross PCIe; 70B weights stay in HBM!
Naive Multi-GPU TP=8 over PCIe Bounce: -28.5% TPS (56 -> 14.8 GB/s)
Naive Disaggregated PD over CPU Bounce + BF16 KV: +32.4% TTFT Tax
120 QPS Regulated Bank Needs 46x H200 (+43.8% GPUs vs CC-Off!)
Production Architecture: PPCIE Hardware NVLink CC + Tiered Routing
1. Enable Multi-GPU Protected PCIe / NVLink CC (PPCIE on H200/B200):
Line-rate AES-GCM-256 engines inside NVLink/NVSwitch encrypt AllReduce
directly GPU-to-GPU without CPU SWIOTLB bounce! TP=8 tax: 28.5% -> 4.8%.
2. Pre-Allocate 32–64 GB SWIOTLB Bounce Buffer (`swiotlb=262144`):
Prevents `DMA_MAPPING_ERROR` crashes under high-QPS token/image streaming.
3. Compress Disaggregated PD KV to FP8 + ConnectX-7 Crypto Offload:
Halves encrypted KV payload; cuts cross-node PD TTFT tax from 32.4% to 6.2%.
4. Selective PII Enclave Routing (25% Regulated PII -> CC-On Pool):
PPCIE NVLink CC Fleet: 34x H200 (vs 46x Naive, -26.1% GPUs)
Selective 25% PII Enclave: 8x CC-On + 24x CC-Off = 32x H200 (1.2% net tax)
Full FIPS 140-3 SPDM Hardware Attestation + Zero Plaintext RAM Exposure
Cloud & AI SA Golden Rule for Confidential AI (H100 / H200 / B200 + Intel TDX / AMD SEV-SNP):
Never run TP>1 or VLM video ingestion through single-GPU CC PCIe bounce buffers (14.8 GB/s ceiling); always enforce PPCIE NVLink hardware encryption and FP8 KV.
